# BoothLedger

> Professional photo booth software for events. Canon DSLR support, custom templates, instant SMS/email sharing, cloud management & AI effects.

BoothLedger is a Windows photo booth application designed for professional event photographers and photo booth operators. It supports Canon DSLR cameras, custom multi-photo templates, direct dye-sublimation printing, and instant sharing via SMS, email, and QR codes. The software includes two AI engines for creative effects like face swap, AI backgrounds, magazine covers, and artistic transformations.

## Pages

- [Home](https://boothledger.com/): Main landing page with features overview, download, and FAQ
- [AI Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/ai-photo-booth): AI-powered photo booth features including face swap, AI backgrounds, and 50+ creative effects
- [Pricing](https://boothledger.com/pricing): Subscription plans starting at EUR 12/month with 30-day free trial
- [Mirror Booth](https://boothledger.com/mirror-booth): Mirror booth software for interactive photo booth experiences
- [Green Screen Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/green-screen-photo-booth): Green screen and AI background removal features
- [Newspaper Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/newspaper-photo-booth): Newspaper photo booth software that turns each guest into a custom A4 front-page newspaper with an editable headline, names and date, printed full-size on-site. "On This Date" mode lets a guest enter a birthday (or any date from 1900 on) and writes the front page from that day — headline, story, captions and classified ads — for $0.03 of AI credit per page, in 8 languages
- [Colouring In Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/colouring-photo-booth): Colouring in photo booth software that converts guest photos into printable A4 colouring pages with AI line art - faces stay recognisable, pages print on plain paper on-site, and guests keep a digital copy
- [Photo Mosaic](https://boothledger.com/photo-mosaic): Guests turn the event album into a photo mosaic from their gallery link — pick any photo or upload a picture/logo and every booth photo becomes a tile. Included free with every gallery.
- [Photo Booth Data Capture](https://boothledger.com/photo-booth-data-capture): GDPR-compliant guest data capture — collects emails and phone numbers with an explicit Yes/No opt-in at the booth (nothing pre-ticked, photo sent either way), consent timestamped, 12-month auto-expiry, one-click erasure, EU hosting, per-event on/off and custom wording, CSV export per event and account-wide. Included in every plan.

- [Photo Booth Software for Canon](https://boothledger.com/blog/photo-booth-software-for-canon): Guide to running Canon DSLR and mirrorless cameras with photo booth software

## Key Features

- Canon DSLR camera integration with live view
- AI face swap and AI background removal
- Custom multi-photo templates
- Direct dye-sublimation printing
- SMS, email, and QR code sharing
- Boomerang and GIF capture
- Cloud sync via BoothLedger Cloud
- BoothLedger Share (https://boothledgershare.photoboothguys.ie): guest share station web app for any tablet, phone or laptop — guests browse the event gallery and share by SMS, email, QR code or download; slideshow with music; same account as the booth. Cloud mode for venues with internet, or the booth serves it over its own Wi-Fi at no-internet venues (view/download work fully offline). The ecosystem is three apps: BoothLedger (desktop, at the event) + BoothLedger Cloud (backend/storage/config) + BoothLedger Share (guest-facing).
- Offline mode with automatic sync
- Mirror booth support
- Green screen and AI backgrounds
- Newspaper front-page templates with full A4 printing
- "On This Date" birthday newspapers: the guest enters a date and AI writes that day's front page, printed with their photo
- Video guestbook recording
